name: Cyclizar
description: Cyclizar, the Mount Pokémon. A Dragon and Normal type.
pokedex_entries: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.
It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider's body heat warms Cyclizar's back and lifts the Pokémon's spirit.
